instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and lean your lower back on it.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you and set your feet wide with toes turned out.
Squat down as the ball rolls up your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: A wide-stance sumo squat holding a dumbbell with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball supports your back and keeps your posture upright.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, then rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing away from you.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended, then lower them back down to shoulder height.
Rotate your wrists back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Lying on a bench, you lower dumbbells to your chest with elbows flared and press back up. It strongly targets the triceps.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Standing, you pull dumbbells up along your body toward chin height. It builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell W-Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: You press dumbbells overhead in a W-shaped path. It trains the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise them.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing away from your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your palms back to facing your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: You curl up with palms up, rotate the palms down, and lower slowly. It works the biceps on the way up and the forearms on the way down.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Jack Press
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Jump your feet out wide as you press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out the arms without arching your back.
Jump your feet together as you lower the weights to your shoulders.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.
description: A jumping jack combined with an overhead press. It raises your heart rate and works the shoulders and legs together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Push-Up Close-Grip Off Dumbbell
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A close grip push-up with your hands on dumbbells. Puts extra focus on the triceps and gives a deeper range.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Single Leg Calf Raise (On A Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: Standing on one leg, you rise up onto your toes with the ball of your foot on a dumbbell. Works the calves with extra range.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Spell Caster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the waist, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell towards the opposite foot, rotating your torso as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A rotational move with a dumbbell, sweeping the weight across the body from low to high. It trains the abs and obliques and builds control.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Lying External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your upper arm against your side and your elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell in your hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your upper arm against your side, slowly rotate your forearm upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying rotation with a light dumbbell, turning the forearm upward with the elbow at the side. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your arms externally, bringing the dumbbells up towards your head while keeping your elbows in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A shoulder exercise raising the arms to the side and rotating the dumbbells upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff and delts.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Curtsey Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest up and hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.
description: A lunge where you step back and across behind you, like a curtsey. It works the glutes and outer hips from a different angle.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Leg Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or by your side.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Sit your hips back and lower under control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press up to stand, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell. It builds leg strength and balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Wrist Supination
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternating Cross Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.

Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Side Plank V. 2
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.

Lower with control, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Lying Floor Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

name: Dumbbell Hang Snatch
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

name: Dumbbell Narrow Squat Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Thor Lift
instructions: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.

Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.

name: Dumbbell Standing Cross Clean
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge To Single Arm Shoulders Press
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.

Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Single Arm Clean Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.

name: Burpee Over The Dumbbell
instructions: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.

Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Twist
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.
description: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bear Plank Alternating Row
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

name: Dumbbell Pullover To Press Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.

Stand up and return to the center.

Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

name: Dumbbell Shoulders Complex
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.

name: Dumbbell Cross Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.

Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

name: Dumbbell Powell Raise

name: Dumbbell Wrist Rotation

instructions: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.

name: Dumbbell Burpee

Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Superman
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Y-Raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward slightly and let your arms hang straight down, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides and up in a Y shape until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Incline T-Raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back on the bench and use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Once at shoulder height, rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward.
Push the dumbbells up with your chest and shoulders, extending your arms fully.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards, and raise them to shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell up overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other dumbbell up overhead.
Continue alternating between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl To Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Once your forearms are vertical, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Carry
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you walk forward, maintaining the dumbbell overhead.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat the exercise.
description: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Hammer Curl And Press
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your back straight.
Exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the curl with your left hand.
After completing the curl with your left hand, exhale and press the dumbbell in your right hand overhead.
Extend your arm fully and hold for a moment at the top.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the press with your left hand.
Continue alternating between curls and presses for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with the opposite arm movement. It trains the glutes, quads and balance.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Rdl Death March
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.
description: Walk forward doing Romanian deadlifts with dumbbells, a balance and hamstring challenge.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Side Plank With Rear Fly
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, keeping your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, with your arm extended straight down towards the ground.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: A dumbbell side plank with a reverse fly. It trains the rear delts, upper back and obliques.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Lying On Floor Chest Press
instructions: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: A dumbbell press performed lying on the floor, which limits the range of motion and is easy on the shoulders.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.
description: A bench press with dumbbells pressed together to keep constant tension in the chest.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: Curl dumbbells one at a time while lying back on an incline bench to stretch and work the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsey Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.
description: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and step behind and across into a curtsey lunge.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.
description: A light external rotation for the rotator cuff.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Lateral Raises
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: Lateral raises with your chest on an incline bench to remove cheating and isolate the delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Hold To Stand
instructions: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.
description: Move from a kneeling position to standing while holding a dumbbell.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Drag Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.
description: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.
description: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Front Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated single-arm raise that targets the front of the shoulder without leg drive helping out.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated On Exercise Ball Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Great for working each leg on its own while the front load keeps you upright.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Box Squat
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.
description: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bench Supported External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A light rotation exercise lying on a bench that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles around the shoulder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.
description: A chest-supported reverse fly done one arm at a time, aimed at the rear delts and upper back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternate Bench Press (High Start)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.
description: A dumbbell bench press where you press one arm at a time, starting with both weights held high. It challenges chest strength and stability.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Alternate Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.
description: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Press Squat (Thighs)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
description: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.
description: A squat with dumbbells held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands strong shoulders and core.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Split Squat Front Foot Elevated With Bosu Ball
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the front foot on a bosu ball for a deeper range and extra balance work.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Leg Calf Raise V. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms and avoid swinging.
description: Seated curls, alternating arms, to build the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl V. 2
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
description: Curling from an incline bench stretches the biceps at the bottom for a deep contraction.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat V. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell for balance and extra load.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Archer
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Shift your weight toward the empty-hand side and bend that knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower with control and shift back to the center.
Repeat all reps, then switch arms.
description: A wide-stance move where one arm extends sideways like drawing a bow. It trains your shoulders and upper back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Reverse Row
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.
description: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. It works your upper back, lats and biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Mid Air Lateral Raises With Switching Palms
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height with palms down.
Turn your palms up in mid air, then back down.
Lower the weights slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
description: A lateral raise where you turn your palms over at the top. It works the side of your shoulders from two angles.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Poliquin Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Avoid swinging your torso.
description: A lateral raise variation with a slight forward lean that hits the side delts with extra range.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Complex Push Up Row Clean And Press
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your ribs and switch sides.
Jump or step your feet toward your hands and stand up, cleaning the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to the floor and return to the push-up position.
Move smoothly and keep your core tight.
description: A flowing combo of push-up, row, clean and press that works the whole body with a pair of dumbbells.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: A one-armed dumbbell snatch, pulling the weight from the floor to overhead in one explosive movement. It trains the hips, legs and shoulders.
author: ExerciseDB / AscendAPI

name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift V. 3
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees almost straight.
Hinge at the hips and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand, keeping your back flat.
description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Low Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench or stand and hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Move the dumbbells in a wide arc.
Bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly under control.
description: A dumbbell fly with a low path that emphasizes the lower chest.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Front Raise
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your reps.
description: A one-arm raise in front of you that trains the front delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Upright Alternate Squeeze Press
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together in front of your chest.
Keep the two dumbbells touching.
Press one dumbbell forward until the arm is straight.
Bring it back and press with the other arm.
Keep squeezing the weights together.
description: Press two dumbbells held together, one arm at a time, while seated upright. It trains the chest with a strong inner squeeze.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Single Spider Curl With Chest Support
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging, dumbbell in hand.
Keep your upper arm vertical.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower fully.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl done lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swinging.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Around The World
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue down to your hips.
Reverse the arc to return.
description: Swing dumbbells in a wide arc over your head while lying on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and chest.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Flat Around The World
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out and back in a wide arc.
Take them down toward your hips.
Reverse the arc with control.
description: Sweep dumbbells from your hips to overhead in a wide arc on a flat bench. It works the shoulders and chest through a long range.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.
description: Press dumbbells overhead one arm at a time. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise V. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the ball of the opposite foot, ideally on a step.
Rest your free hand on a wall or rail for balance.
Lift your heel as high as you can, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the step level, then repeat and switch legs.
description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise With Chest Support
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest against the pad.
description: A front raise done chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts without momentum.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Push Up Front Raise
instructions: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells.
Do a push up.
Lift one dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate arms.
description: A push up on dumbbells followed by a front raise. It trains the chest, arms and core.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Close Grip Press Variation
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells together over your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Lower to your chest.
Press up.
Keep the dumbbells touching.
description: A close grip dumbbell press on an incline. It targets the triceps and upper chest.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Spider Curl
instructions: Stand and hinge forward, bracing against a support.
Let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl up.
Squeeze.
Lower and switch arms.
description: A standing one-arm spider curl bent forward. It isolates the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bar Grip Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell vertically by its bar with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down while keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.
description: Wide stance squat holding one dumbbell by its bar between the legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.
description: Rotating a dumbbell side to side while balanced on a stability ball. It challenges the obliques and balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Ipsilateral Split Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step into a split stance, the dumbbell on the same side as your front leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: Split squat with the dumbbell held on the same side as the working front leg. It tests balance and leg strength.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Gittleson Shrug
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without rolling your shoulders.
description: Seated shrug variation with a dumbbell in each hand that builds the upper traps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension On Stability Ball
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arm back up.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: Overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell while seated on a stability ball. The ball adds a core challenge.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise On Stability Ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: Seated side raise performed on a stability ball. It trains the side delts and trunk balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Arnold Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Brace your core.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
description: Rotating press with dumbbells, done one arm at a time while standing. It works all parts of the shoulder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Alternate Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit at the edge of a bench and lean forward with dumbbells hanging below your knees.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly bent.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.
description: Seated bent over fly done one arm at a time to hit the rear delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternate Arnold Press
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower it while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching.
description: Seated Arnold press alternating arms. The twist works the front and side delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Front Raise With Chest Support
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: Front raise with your chest supported on an incline bench to reduce swinging. It isolates the front delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Arnold Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms overhead.
Lower while rotating back to palms facing you.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching.
description: The rotating shoulder press popularized by Arnold, hitting all heads of the delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly in that reverse grip.
Rotate your palms back up at the bottom.
description: A seated curl that turns your palms down on the way back, training biceps and forearms.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Arnold Press
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in one hand at chest height, palm facing you.
Press up while rotating your palm forward.
Fully extend overhead.
Lower while rotating back.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated one arm Arnold press for shoulders with rotation through the movement.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Face Down Lying Shoulder Press
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells at ear height.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the bench.
description: A face down press on an incline bench that works the rear shoulder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Soften your elbows slightly and keep that bend.
Open your arms wide until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly without resting your weight.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above you.
Move slowly and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
description: A chest fly performed lying on the floor, which limits the range at the bottom to protect the shoulders. It isolates the pecs.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Low Fly
instructions: Stand with feet staggered and hold a dumbbell at your side with a slight elbow bend.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sweep the dumbbell out and up in an arc to chest height in front of you.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly along the same arc.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single arm fly that sweeps the dumbbell from low up to the chest. It works the upper pecs and front shoulder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lying Floor Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and avoid flaring them.
description: A triceps extension lying on the floor, bending only at the elbows. The floor limits the range and keeps tension on the triceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Close Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells with palms forward and hands close together.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid swinging your torso.
description: A biceps curl with the dumbbells held close together. This emphasises the outer biceps through a controlled curl.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Front And Back Tate Press
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms close to your torso.
Lower the weights with elbows flared until they touch your chest.
Extend your elbows to push the weights up and slightly forward.
Return to the start in a controlled path.
Keep your back straight and avoid arching.
description: A seated triceps move where the dumbbells go from the chest outward in front and back. It hits the triceps from a unique angle.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you lower, raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Lower the dumbbells as you return.
Alternate legs for each rep.
description: Step back into a lunge and raise the dumbbells in front. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Devils Press
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then step or jump your feet back.
Do a push up if you like.
Jump your feet forward and stand up, swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control.
Keep your back flat and move with rhythm.
description: A full body move: burpee onto dumbbells, then swing them overhead. It builds power and conditioning.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Cuban Press
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your thighs.
Row them up to chest height with elbows high.
Rotate your forearms upward.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse the path slowly.
Use light weights.
description: A seated move combining an upright row, rotation and press. It strengthens shoulders and rotator cuff.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Banded Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench with a band across your upper back and hands.
Hold dumbbells at chest level.
Press up against the band.
Lock out at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet flat.
description: A dumbbell bench press with a band adding tension at lockout. It builds chest strength.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Partials Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides.
Stay within the mid range, between hip and shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid shrugging.
description: Short range lateral raises that keep tension on the side delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Fly Against Chains
instructions: Lie on a bench with chains.
Hold weights above your chest.
Open arms.
Stretch your chest.
Bring weights together.
Keep elbows soft.
description: A chest fly with chains adding load.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell 4 Ways Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand and a slight knee bend.
Raise both arms out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower, then raise them to the front to shoulder height.
Lower, then hinge forward slightly and raise them out to the rear.
Return and finish with a raise to the sides again.
Keep the weights light and avoid swinging.
description: A shoulder series that moves the dumbbells through four raise positions in one set. It hits all heads of the delts with light weight.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Rear Delt Row
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward with a flat back, arms hanging.
Pull the weights toward your sides with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest close to your thighs.
description: A seated bent-over row with elbows flared wide to hit the rear delts. Sitting keeps your legs from helping.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Two Front Raise With Chest Support
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height or just above.
Pause for a second.
Lower under control.
Keep your head neutral and your movement smooth.
description: A front raise with both arms while lying chest down on an incline bench. The support stops you from cheating with your back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Close Grip Press
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Hold them close together with palms facing each other.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and ribs down.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
Do not arch your lower back.
description: A seated overhead press with the dumbbells held close together, palms facing in. It works the front delts and triceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral To Front Raise
instructions: Sit tall on a bench holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them back to your sides.
Raise both arms to the front to shoulder height.
Lower and repeat.

description: A seated raise that combines a side raise and a front raise in one rep. It builds the delts from two angles.

name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Fly (With Support) V. 2
instructions: Hinge forward and brace your free hand on a bench or support.
Hold a light dumbbell hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight elbow bend.
Lift until your arm is about parallel to the floor.
Pause and lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms straight up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with your legs straight out and heels just off the floor.
Lean back slightly with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.

Move smoothly and breathe.

name: Dumbbell V Up V. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a dumbbell overhead.

Lift your legs and torso together, reaching the dumbbell toward your feet.

name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Twisting Sit Up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Static Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a long split stance, rear heel lifted.

Bend both knees and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up without moving your feet.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glute at the top for a second.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged hip bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It hits the glutes hard and challenges hip stability.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lying Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a bench and grip the edge for support.
Have a dumbbell gripped between your feet, or placed by a partner, with legs straight.
Bend your knees and curl the weight toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
description: Lying face down, you curl a dumbbell held between your feet toward your glutes. A simple way to train the back of the thighs without a machine.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Straight Legs Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee and a flat back.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs and dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.
description: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Pullover On Floor
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie back on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them bent throughout.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest and repeat.
description: A pullover with the elbows kept bent, lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the chest and lats.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Side Bend V. 2
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place your other hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, keeping your hips still.
Squeeze the opposite side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternate Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other arm.
Avoid swinging; keep alternating for your reps.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Twisted Fly
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide in an arc with elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your wrists as you lower until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together, twisting them to finish with palms inward.
Control the weight on the way down.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean And Jerk
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, then drive them forward and shrug as you pull the dumbbell up.
Drop under it and catch it at your shoulder with a slight knee bend.
Dip a little, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the hang under control.
description: An explosive lift that takes a dumbbell from the hang to your shoulder and then overhead. It builds power through the hips, legs and shoulders.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Push Jerk
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs explosively.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you straighten, then lock out your arms.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.
description: An explosive overhead lift that uses a leg drive to send dumbbells overhead. It builds power and shoulder strength.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lying Close Grip Parallel Row On Rack
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lying Wide Grip Row On Rack
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Power Clean And Jerk
instructions: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.

name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Side Bridge With Bent Leg
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell One Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squats

Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Squat Hold Calf Raise

name: Dumbbell Step Up With Knee Raise

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Military Press

name: Dumbbell Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up

name: Dumbbell Front Plank Arm Raise
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.

name: Dumbbell Crunch Up

Lower back down slowly.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up

name: Dumbbell Seated Tuck Crunch On Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.

Extend your legs back out under control.

name: Dumbbell Front Plank Arm Leg Raise

name: Dumbbell Seated Tuck Twisting Crunch On Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row To Squat

name: Dumbbell Bench Dip

name: Dumbbell Bench Dip With Legs Elevated

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Single Arm Row V. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees slightly bent.

name: Dumbbell Bridge Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the floor or a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat V. 2

name: Dumbbell Decline Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a decline bench with the dumbbell held between your feet.

Curl your heels up toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your hips.

name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit Up
instructions: Hook your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell above your chest.

name: Dumbbell Decline Sit Up
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and hold a dumbbell against your chest.

Curl up until your torso is upright.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Deep Push Up And Renegade Row

name: Dumbbell Floor Wiper
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat And Biceps Curl

description: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Overhead Sit Up With Legs On Bench
instructions: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead with the legs resting on a bench. The extra reach makes the abs work harder.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Z Press V. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.
description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternate Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.
description: A seated floor press that alternates arms, which adds anti-lean trunk work. It trains the shoulders and the core.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing T Spine Press
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Hands Torsion
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
description: A standing twisting move holding a dumbbell that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl Rotate
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.
description: A standing reverse curl that ends with a forearm rotation. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Pullover V. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.
description: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.
description: A chest-supported raise on an incline bench to a Y position with one arm. It builds the lower traps and rear delts.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Scapular External Rotation
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Scapular External Rotation (Front Pov)
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A light dumbbell rotation that trains the rear shoulder and rotator cuff.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Powell Raise
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.
description: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge From Deficit
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.
description: Reverse lunge with the front foot raised for a deeper range, hitting the glutes and quads.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Hyperextension
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.
description: Hyperextension with a dumbbell held to your chest to load the lower back and glutes.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.
description: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Standing Front And Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: Combined raise that hits the front and side delts in one rep.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat With Calf Raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.
description: Goblet squat finished with a calf raise as you stand.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.
description: Wide-stance goblet squat that targets the glutes and inner thighs.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.
description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with a dumbbell held at the chest.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat From Deficit
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.
description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the front foot raised for greater depth.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Goblet Wall Sit
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.
description: Wall sit holding a dumbbell at the chest for extra load.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Hack Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.
description: Hack squat with dumbbells held behind the legs.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Glute Dominant Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Contralateral Glute Dominant Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A Bulgarian split squat with one dumbbell held in the opposite hand to the front leg.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Curl
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl performed while hinged forward at the hips. The position removes swing and keeps tension on the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Ipsilateral Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-leg deadlift holding the dumbbell on the same side as the standing leg, for hamstrings and balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Prone W Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells while bending the elbows into a W shape. It works the rear delts and the upper back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Kickback
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: A chest-supported kickback on an incline bench that isolates the triceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Triceps Kickback
instructions: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Triceps Extension V. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge Chest Press
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Y Raise
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.
description: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out and up into a Y shape. It trains the shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust V. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.
description: A deadlift with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Plank
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Underhand Renegade Row
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row On Stability Ball
instructions: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row Walk
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Opposite Shoulder Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Twist Down Up Raise
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Preacher Swing Curl
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
