author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Curtsey Lunge V. 2
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.
description: A lunge where one leg crosses behind you, working the glutes and outer hips with added load.
author: openGym contributors

name: Weighted Dumbbell Lying Knee Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Lying Straight Arm Press On Floor
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.

author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift To Squat
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.
description: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Sitting Good Morning
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.
description: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Step Over Box
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.
description: Stepping across a box with dumbbells in your hands. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Elevated Heel Front Squat
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up to stand.
description: A front squat with a dumbbell and raised heels, which keeps your torso upright and puts the work on the quads.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Alternating Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Alternate arms each rep.
description: A squat into an overhead press, alternating arms with dumbbells. It works legs and shoulders together.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
description: A two-arm dumbbell row with your chest on an incline bench. It isolates the back without strain on the lower spine.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.
description: A curl performed chest-down on an incline bench so the arms hang straight. It removes swing and puts the stress on the biceps.
author: openGym contributors

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.
description: A seated lateral raise lifting one dumbbell at a time. Sitting reduces body swing so the side delts do the work.
author: openGym contributors
